headlines.title: Federal judge orders pro-Trump TV ads funded by taxpayers off air immediately
headlines.description: In an earlier filing, the administration said it had planned to stop ad purchases Sunday.

headlines.title: South Carolina Senate rivals spar over Iran, AI and Trump in debate
headlines.description: Annie Andrews and Darline Graham are running to replace the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, and the winner will make history as the first female senator elected from South Carolina.

headlines.title: Saudi airport struck again after deadly attack that killed American
headlines.description: An unidentified projectile struck Saudi Arabia’s main international airport Sunday, injuring people a day after a deadly missile attack at the same site raised questions about whether the United States would join another conflict in the region. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez reports.

headlines.title: Trump claims Russia and Ukraine agree to energy ceasefire
headlines.description: President Trump claimed Sunday that Ukraine and Russia have agreed to an “energy ceasefire” as part of the ongoing conflict. There was no immediate confirmation from Moscow, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says they are ready to take all necessary steps to end the war. NBC News’ Yamiche Alcindor reports.

headlines.title: The Commanders had seconds left to secure a win — and blew it
headlines.description: The Washington Commanders were on their way to beating the New York Giants in overtime. Then they ran out the clock on themselves and settled for a tie.

headlines.title: The 49ers look like the NFL’s best team after surviving a heavyweight fight
headlines.description: Behind quarterback Brock Purdy, the San Francisco 49ers beat the Seattle Seahawks on the road — and appear to be the NFL’s best team through five weeks.

headlines.title: Kelly Clarkson says a Brooklyn store snubbed her. The shop says the item she wanted wasn’t for sale.
headlines.description: Clarkson blasted Art of Play, alleging it treated her like she “couldn’t afford” its merchandise. The store says the resulting backlash was “surreal.”

headlines.title: In new Elon Musk documentary, his lieutenants are the most damning voices
headlines.description: ‘Musk,’ the new film from Alex Gibney, features interviews with more than the usual critics of the Tesla and SpaceX CEO.

headlines.title: Food pantries overwhelmed by Trump cuts
headlines.description: Those on the front lines of feeding their neighbors in rural West Virginia say they face unprecedented challenges brought on by Washington.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: ‘I just had the flu’: James Talarico shoots down conservative speculation about absence
headlines.description: In an interview with NBC Dallas-Fort Worth, the Democrat again challenged his Republican opponent, Ken Paxton, to a debate in the Texas Senate race.
